shared_prompt: Create a bright, approachable, high-fidelity adult editorial woodblock asset assembled from thin hand-cut washi, layered rice paper, and painted cardstock. Use deckled fiber edges, restrained relief, subtle black ink contours, convincing handmade paper shadows, precise business-editorial proportions, and controlled cobalt, teal, sunflower, coral, cream, and indigo accents. Keep the subject fully visible as a clean modular silhouette. Avoid plastic, clay, foam, plush, glossy 3D rendering, chunky toy blocks, kawaii forms, preschool proportions, words, numbers, logos, watermarks, loose fragments, and authoritative factual text.
chroma_prompt: Place the isolated subject on a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background with no shadow, gradient, texture, reflection, or floor plane. Do not use #00ff00 in the subject.
